items.title: Chart values show only while you touch
items.description: Press or slide along any chart to see its values; lift your finger and they hide again. A quick tap shows the value for a moment.

items.title: Swing scanner
items.description: Nifty 200 stocks ranked by daily-chart swing setups (breakout, pullback, bounce), with RSI, volume and an entry, stop and target plan for each.

items.title: High volume scan
items.description: See which stocks are trading on unusually heavy volume, and sort by volume, price change or volume spike.

items.title: More accurate valuation (X/2 · X/3)
items.description: Lowest P/E and EPS growth are now calculated more carefully, and cyclical or unreliable results are flagged with a "Things to check" card.

items.title: Swipe up for More
items.description: On phones, swipe up anywhere along the bottom bar to open the More menu, on every page.

items.title: Smarter bottom navigation
items.description: The bar now hides only while the keyboard is actually open, so it no longer disappears when you aren't typing.

items.title: Tab taps go back first
items.description: Tapping a tab while inside a holding or edit screen takes you to that tab's first page. Tap it again there to refresh.

items.title: Portfolio export
items.description: Export your complete portfolio report as a PDF from Settings.

items.title: Cleaner bottom bar
items.description: A solid white bar with the quick-add "+" centred inside it, and a smoother, medium-speed shrink as you reach the end of a page.

items.title: Valuation loads on demand
items.description: In X/2 · X/3 valuation, picking a stock only fills the search box. The valuation loads when you press Get valuation.

items.title: Update notice stays dismissed
items.description: Close the update notice once and it won't return for the same version. The update list now opens instantly.

items.title: New version moved into Settings
items.description: The New version button now sits at the end of the Settings menu, right below Data, so the Settings heading stays clean.

items.title: Roomier Settings menu
items.description: The menu on the left of Settings is a little wider, so your photo, name and every row have more space to breathe.
